title: Can Rats Really Predict Earthquakes?

scenes.text: When the 2011 Japan quake hit, rats supposedly ran out seconds early.
People believe rats can sense and warn us about an incoming earthquake.
scenes.label: Rats predict quakes

scenes.text: Scientific studies show rats react to the same ground vibrations as humans; there’s no evidence they detect quakes before instruments.
scenes.label: No early warning ability

scenes.text: Rats feel the shake, they don’t foresee it.
scenes.label: Shake, not foresight
scenes.sub: They respond to actual motion, not a sixth sense.

scenes.text: Follow if you love learning something new.

description: The idea of rat‑run warnings sounds cinematic, but science tells a different story. Learn why this myth doesn’t hold up.
